child.value: GZEA14R GR GTS Hatchback 5dr Auto 8sp GR-FOUR 1.6T The 12th-generation Toyota Corolla came in 2018 as a five-door hatch or a slightly-stretched four-door sedan. The hatch is handy and versatile, the sedan roomy and suave. Regular Corollas have a 126kW/203Nm 2.0-litre looking after power delivery, while the 1.8-litre 3.5L/100km hybrid looks after fuel economy. The AWD GR, with its blustering 221kW/400Nm 1.6-litre turbo engine capable of putting down 5.3-sec zero to 100km/h times, came in 2023 as the most significant addition to the range. All Corollas except the six-speed manual and eight-speed automatic GR drive through CVT transmissions. Safety tech includes autonomous emergency braking, adaptive cruise control, pedestrian avoidance and lane-departure warning/lane-keep assist.
